verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is a search/data platform, not an agentic client that would consume tools from other MCP servers; the evidence instead shows Elasticsearch ships an official MCP *server* (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) so other AI agents can call into Elasticsearch — the reverse role from this story. This 'plug MCP servers in to use their tools' client-side axis is a category error for a database/search engine.
